name: Deluge The
overview: The Scripture reveals that the deluge was God's righteous response to the pervasive wickedness and corruption of mankind, as seen in the continual evil imaginations and violence filling the earth (Genesis 6:5, 6:11-12). Grieved by man's sin, God declared His intent to destroy all flesh from the earth, demonstrating both His justice and sorrow over human rebellion (Genesis 6:6-7, 6:13). This event underscores God's holiness and the certainty of judgment, while also setting the stage for His covenant faithfulness through the salvation of Noah and his family.
